data.text:
MANOY –GONE BUT NEVER FORGOTTEN: DEATH ANNIVERSARY OF EDDIE GARCIA 

On June 20, 2019, the country lost a screen legend. Eddie Garcia, whose career spanned nearly a century,  passed following a tragic on-set accident. 

Today, his legacy lives on, not only through his body of work but also in the protections now afforded to all audiovisual workers under Republic Act No. 11996, also known as the Eddie Garcia Law.
